documents.title: UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Board Meeting Outcome for UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Nitin Spinners reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results, highlighting record quarterly revenue, exports, and fabric business revenue alongside a sustained EBITDA margin of 17.8%. Management noted that trial production of griege woven fabric has commenced as part of its ongoing brownfield expansion, with full commissioning expected by December 2026. The company continues to advance its integrated manufacturing capabilities, expand its renewable energy mix, and benefit from government policy incentives such as RIPS 2024. Growth levers include increased captive yarn consumption, premium product expansion, and strong export positioning. Nitin Spinners reported its highest ever quarterly revenue of INR875 crores for Q1 FY27, driven by improved yarn realizations, better demand environment, and optimum capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is well-positioned to sustain momentum and deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.
guidance.quote: With favourable trade policies, an expanding presence in value-added fabrics, a well-diversified export footprint and an increasing share of renewable energy in our energy mix, we are well positioned to sustain this momentum and deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.

guidance.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 27.
guidance.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

guidance.claim: Management states that the kind of product mix and cost metrics of the company should keep margins in the range of 16% to 20%.
guidance.quote: I guided or have informed that the kind of product mix which our company has, we should be in the range of 16% to 20%. I still maintain the same, that we should be -- kind of product profile as well as the kind of cost metrics we have, we should be still remain in this range.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27, supported by the commercialization of our additional capacities of fabric and yarn, which will further strengthen our manufacturing capabilities, improve profitability, and support sustainable long-term growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports contributed 68% to quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports contributed 68% to the quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.

demand_outlook.claim: FY27 commenced on a positive note for the textile industry, supported by an improvement in demand from the last quarter following the removal of additional tariffs by the U.S.
demand_outlook.quote: FY27 has commenced on a positive note for the textile industry. This positive momentum has been supported by an improvement in demand from the last quarter itself following the removal of the additional tariffs by the U.S.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by growth across the downstream sector and spinning industry consolidation.
demand_outlook.quote: We anticipate that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by demand coming from growth across the downstream sector and the consolidation of the spinning industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Increased demand for cotton yarn in the export market from China was one of the factors for a better demand scenario for Indian spinners.
demand_outlook.quote: The increased demand of cotton yarn in export market from China was one of the factors for a better demand scenario for the Indian spinners.

demand_outlook.claim: The recently implemented India-U.K. FTA is expected to support India's exports by opening up new sourcing and export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The recently implemented India U.K. FTA is also expected to support India's exports by opening up new sourcing and export opportunities for the Indian textile sector.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1FY27 revenue performance was driven by improved yarn realizations and better demand.
demand_outlook.quote: This performance was driven by improved yarn realizations and better demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for the Indian textile industry remains positive due to trade agreements, policy measures, and improved cotton price parity.
demand_outlook.quote: The long-term outlook for the Indian textile industry remains positive, supported by various trade agreements and policy measures, as well as improved price parity between international and domestic cotton.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has commenced trial production of griege woven fabric.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity expansion front, we have commenced trial production of griege woven fabric.

capex_expansion.claim: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced and full commissioning expected by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced. Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity addition is progressing as scheduled with the expansion of fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by an additional 74,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, our -- one of our future growth driver will be our capacity addition, which is going -- progressing as schedule with the expansion of our fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans are progressing in full swing with commercial operation expected from Q3FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex Plans are progressing in full swing and expected commercial operation from Q3FY27

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization and ongoing cost saving measures.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization and ongoing cost saving measures.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 17.78%, an increase of 376 bps year-on-year due to improved realization and cost-saving initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for this quarter stood at 17.78% against Q1 FY26 margins of 14.02% is an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis and 261 bps on quarter-on-quarter basis. That is due to improved realization and cost saving initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to the West Asia war.
margins_costs.quote: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY27, the spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric at over 92% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: In FY27, our spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity is running at similar production levels of 98% capacity utilization, beyond which volume increases are not possible.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to your first question, there is basically if you see the production capacity it is running at the similar production capacities. So we are running at 98% capacity utilization. And accordingly the increase in volumes is not possible beyond the capacity which we have.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current production capacity stands at 1.10 Lakh Tons for yarn, 40 Mn Mtr for woven fabric, and 11,000 Tons for knitted fabric.
orders_capacity.quote: Current Production Capacity 1.10 Lakh Tons 40 Mn Mtr 11,000 Tons Bhilwara Plant, Rajasthan Chittorgarh Plant , Rajasthan Yarn Woven Fabric Knitted Fabric

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated it would not be prudent to go for a buyback at this point because the company is in a growth phase, deploying capital for growth through internal accruals and loans.
capital_allocation.quote: I think at this point of time we are in a growth phase. We are deploying our capital for the growth purposes, internal accruals as well as we are also taking some loans as well. So it would not be some it would not be prudent for us to go for buyback at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cotton quality in the previous year was not that good, prompting most spinners in India to import cotton from outside the country.
risks_headwinds.quote: As far as the quality is concerned, the last year quality, the cotton quality was not that good and that has that was one of the reason which has prompted most of the spinners from India to import the cotton from outside the country.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of the ongoing expansion projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management states that the renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 27.
management_commitments.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to ramp up all yarn capacities by the 31st of March of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we would have ramped up all our capacities by 31st of March of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated confidence in delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27 supported by commercialization of additional capacities.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27, supported by the commercialization of our additional capacities of fabric and yarn, which will further strengthen our manufacturing capabilities, improve profitability, and support sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
